body.name: Common-basal compatibility fiber
body.construction: \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)=\{\eta\in\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}:\bigl(\operatorname{skel}(M_k(\eta)),\operatorname{UC}(M_k(\eta))\bigr)_{k=0}^{K}=\mathcal O\}\). Each member supplies the observational selected law \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\) for \(M_0(\eta)\) and, for every \(k\in[K]\), the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\) faithful to \(M_k(\eta)\); neither arm law is substituted for this pooled law. Equality preserves every adjacency and every unshielded collider on each full domain \(U_k\), including all indicator-involving instances.
